The module deliberately hijacks global https/http requests for Claude endpoints, reads a local credentials file, captures full request bodies (overriding write/end), and forwards those requests to a remote server defined in credentials.server. It also strips/filters Authorization headers, returns mocked success responses when credentials are missing or the proxy errors, and logs/forwards data — behaviour consistent with covert man-in-the-middle / data exfiltration of API requests and conversational content. These actions are intentional and can leak sensitive information, so classify as malicious.
